policy_text:
Deploys to production require human approval.
No more than 3 deploys to the same environment in any rolling 24-hour period.
Never print or reveal secret values.
Never run destructive shell commands.

clauses.source_sentence: Deploys to production require human approval.
No more than 3 deploys to the same environment in any rolling 24-hour period.
Never print or reveal secret values.

ambiguities.question: Should the approval rule cover production only, or staging as well?

options.label: Production only
options.description: Only deploys to production are held for a human.

options.label: Staging and production
options.description: Deploys to staging or production are held for a human.

ambiguities.question: Should the 24-hour window for the 3-deploy limit slide with time, or reset at midnight?

options.label: Rolling 24 hours
options.description: Counts deploys from the last 24 hours, measured from each request.

options.label: Calendar day (UTC)
options.description: Counts deploys since midnight UTC and resets each day.

ambiguities.question: How strict should the shell rule be?

options.label: Block known destructive commands
options.description: A deny-list: rm -rf, DROP TABLE, force-push and similar are blocked; everything else runs.

options.label: Allow read-only commands only
options.description: An allow-list: only known read-only commands (ls, git status, kubectl get ...) may run.
